title: the WSG airborne fall chance and riding proficiency
audit_label: R461 WSG airborne fall chance pin audit
audit_comment: The Chapter 5 closer: the fall-chance system (printed p. 48) and the airborne riding proficiency (printed p. 49) pin as rules/wsgfallair.h (NEW, prefix wfa): the 0% base with the seven reduction modifiers (the full-body strap -200, the lower-body strap -150, the proficiency -50, the saddle -10, the stirrups -10, the -2 per ability point above 12 with the strength cap 18) and the seven increase modifiers (the hands-free +50, the overload +20, the faster-than-normal +20, the unwilling mount +20, the inclement weather +20, the not-level +10, the +2 per ability point below 12 and the +1 per wind mph above the 30-mph threshold), the every-three-turns check cadence restarting on each landing with the bad-conditions once-per-round exception, and the proficiency pins (the per-category slots with the dragon-and-griffon two-slot example, the -50/+50 hands-free negation, no mount control, the feats under ideal conditions only, the nonproficient automatic feat failure).

banner.title: The WSG AIRBORNE FALL CHANCE AND RIDING PROFICIENCY pins, R461: the Chapter 5 closer - the to-fall-or-not-to-fall system (the 0% base on smooth level flight at the full normal rate; the reduction ladder: the full-body strap, the lower-body strap, the proficiency, the saddle, the stirrups, the per-point ability rule over the 12 threshold with the 18 strength cap; the increase ladder: the free hands, the overload, the faster-than-normal flight, the unwilling mount, the inclement weather, the not-level flight, the below-12 per-point rule, the wind ladder over the 30-mph threshold; the every-three-turns check with the landing restart and the once-per-round exception) and the airborne riding proficiency (the per-category slots, the hands-free negation, the no-control rule, the ideal-conditions feats, the nonproficient auto-fail).
banner.provenance: The read: the OCR session 8d6a65a0, pdf pages 49-50 = printed 48-49, cross-checked against the second OCR copy - the two read word-for-word identical. The sign convention is pinned by the p. 49 text: the proficiency enjoys a -50% modifier that effectively negates the +50% for riding without holding on, so the first six table rows are reductions and the last seven are increases over the 0% base.

consts.name: wfaBaseFallChancePct
consts.comment: The base chance of falling: 0 percent - the mount giving a smooth and level flight at its full normal movement rate.

consts.name: wfaStrapFullBodyPct
consts.comment: Reduction: the rider's entire body (upper and lower) securely strapped onto the mount.

consts.name: wfaStrapLowerBodyPct
consts.comment: Reduction: the rider's lower body only securely strapped onto the mount.

consts.name: wfaAirborneProfPct
consts.comment: Reduction: the rider has proficiency in airborne riding in the appropriate category.

consts.name: wfaSaddlePct
consts.comment: Reduction: the rider is using a saddle.

consts.name: wfaStirrupsPct
consts.comment: Reduction: the saddle is equipped with stirrups.

consts.name: wfaPerAbilityAbove12Pct
consts.comment: Reduction per point of rider's dexterity above 12 and rider's strength above 12.

consts.name: wfaAbilityModThreshold
consts.comment: The ability-score threshold the per-point fall modifiers key on.

consts.name: wfaStrengthCap
consts.comment: Strength reads as 18 at most for the per-point fall modifier.

consts.name: wfaPerAbilityBelow12Pct
consts.comment: Increase per point of rider's dexterity below 12 and rider's strength below 12.

consts.name: wfaFreeHandsPct
consts.comment: Increase: the rider is not strapped onto the mount and not holding on - hands free or carrying something.

consts.name: wfaOverloadPct
consts.comment: Increase: the mount is carrying more than its normal load limit.

consts.name: wfaFasterThanNormalPct
consts.comment: Increase: the mount is moving faster than its full normal movement rate - diving, dodging, performing combat maneuvers.

consts.name: wfaUnwillingMountPct
consts.comment: Increase: the mount's demeanor is unwilling or rebellious and the creature is not charmed, subdued or similarly influenced.

consts.name: wfaInclementWeatherPct
consts.comment: Increase: inclement weather - sandstorm, heavy precipitation, or worse.

consts.name: wfaNotFlyingLevelPct
consts.comment: Increase: the mount is not flying level - sharp turns, loops, and the like.

consts.name: wfaWindThresholdMph
consts.comment: The wind-velocity threshold the per-mph fall modifier keys on.

consts.name: wfaPerWindMphAbove30Pct
consts.comment: Increase per mph of wind velocity greater than the threshold.

consts.name: wfaFallCheckEveryTurns
consts.comment: The fall chance is checked at least once every three turns while airborne - assuming smooth and normal flight.

consts.name: wfaBadConditionsPerRounds
consts.comment: Under bad weather, an uncooperative mount or abrupt changes of direction and speed, a check may be called for as often as once per round.

bools.name: wfaChanceUnlessFastened
bools.comment: A character always has a chance of falling from the back of an airborne mount unless he is securely fastened to the creature.

bools.name: wfaSaddleNoAttachmentWorse
bools.comment: Sitting in a saddle (or some other kind of seat) without being actually attached to the creature increases the chance.

bools.name: wfaNoSaddleWorseStill
bools.comment: Riding without a saddle or some means of retaining the hold on the mount increases the chance further.

bools.name: wfaCheckRestartsOnLanding
bools.comment: The three-turn check count begins anew each time the mount lands and takes off.

bools.name: wfaBadConditionsMayCheckPerRound
bools.comment: While the unusual conditions persist the DM may call for a check as often as once per round.

bools.name: wfaNonproficientAutoFails
bools.comment: A nonproficient character attempting any of the special airborne feats automatically fails and suffers the appropriate consequences.

bools.name: wfaProficiencyPerCategory
bools.comment: Choosing proficiency in airborne riding requires specifying the category of mount to which the skill pertains.

bools.name: wfaTwoCategoriesTwoSlots
bools.comment: A character cannot be proficient in riding both a dragon and a griffon without using two proficiency slots.

bools.name: wfaProfNegatesFreeHands
bools.comment: The -50% proficiency modifier effectively negates the +50% for riding without holding on, so a proficient character rides safely with both hands free under normal conditions.

bools.name: wfaProfImpartsNoControl
bools.comment: The proficiency imparts no special ability to control or cajole an unwilling or uncooperative mount.

bools.name: wfaFeatsIdealConditionsOnly
bools.comment: The special feats are performable under ideal (not perilous) conditions only - the ability is safety from falling plus the feats.

examples.note: the book example: the proficiency -50% negates the +50% hands-free under normal conditions
the full-body strap is strictly more protective than the lower-body-only strap
the saddle and stirrups reductions sum to -20
the symmetric per-point ladder: four points above 12 (-8%) mirrors four below (+8%)
a 40-mph wind: 10 mph over the threshold at +1% per mph gives +10%
